shared_elements: repeated upright linear objects or signs
justification: The most specific overlap is that both surfaces include schematic profile animals and human/anthropomorphic figures rendered in incised/relief outline, with some repeated linear signs or bands. The biggest difference is that A is a horizontal narrative procession centered on a wheeled vehicle, large animals, attendants, and weapons/standards, whereas B is a vertically stacked composition of isolated symbolic creatures and signs with no chariot or comparable scene structure.
